video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Coach Charles Lee

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.text: The flexibility comes with, you know, I think this group allows you to play a lot of different ways and so the versatility of the group is what gives me so much flexibility to play a lot of different ways, depending on who's healthy, depending on what we keep learning about our team and what I think their strengths are. But overall, our identity is to come out defensively and try to be one of the the best defensive teams in the NBA. We understand if you want to be a team that wins a lot of games in this league, you have to be good on both sides of the floor and so being good in transition, being great in the half court to try to keep teams out of the paint, then trying to finish possessions. If you can rebound the ball and get out, it helps us then all of a sudden on the other end with our pace, it helps us be able to trust the pass whenever we're trying to make rim reads and paint reads, and then I think that we have a really competitive relentless group that wants to crash the glass.
quotes.news_angle: Coach Charles Lee says the Hornets' primary identity will be built on becoming a top-tier defensive team.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee says the Hornets' identity this season is clear. We are looking to be one of the best defensive teams in the NBA, and it starts with being great in the half court and finishing possessions.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.text: I'm so glad to be reunited with Dennis. It's been fun watching his career from afar. He's just gotten better and better, I think every team he's gone to. He's grown as a as a leader, a professional. He's impacted a ton of regular season and playoff games and so we're excited to have him. I think that he brings a lot of NBA corporate knowledge. Defensively, there's a competitive spirit to him that I absolutely love and then offensively, as fast as we want to play, he's like a blur, you give him the ball with the ball in his hands. I also think that he's going to help us be able to touch the paint a little bit more, get to the rim and and create some some better shots down the stretch.
quotes.pull_quote: he brings a lot of NBA corporate knowledge
quotes.news_angle: Charles Lee praises Dennis Schroder for his leadership and ability to impact the Hornets' offense.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee is excited to reunite with Dennis Schroder. He says Schroder brings valuable NBA experience and a competitive spirit, and will help the team touch the paint and create better shots.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.text: I think we have a very deep talented roster, but most teams, like you see a lot of success when that team can learn how to gel and come together really quickly. So I think that we've been intentional as a staff of what are we doing on the court and off the court to help this team hopefully expedite that process and get up to speed with one another.
quotes.pull_quote: most teams like you see a lot of success when that team can learn how to gel
quotes.news_angle: Charles Lee emphasizes the importance of team chemistry for the Hornets' deep roster.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says the Hornets have a deep and talented roster, but the key to success will be how quickly the team can gel and come together.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.text: I thought we got to see last year in some of his stints that he had with the Hornets, but also, he I thought he did a great job of helping impact winning with our with the Swarm as well and led them to a a championship. But I've seen a guy that grows continuously defensively. He knows he's got to work on that area and and figure out like what is his paint presence going to be like. Obviously being an undersized big, but this year I look forward to him trying to expand his game a little bit, maybe shoot the three a little bit more. He's already shown in the G League and and games with us, he's great on the glass. He's just got a knack for scoring and knowing where the ball is and and creating extra possessions for your team.
quotes.pull_quote: I look forward to him trying to expand his game a little bit, maybe shoot the three
quotes.news_angle: Charles Lee wants PJ Washington to expand his offensive game by shooting more threes.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee wants to see PJ Washington expand his game this season. Lee says he is looking for Washington to shoot the three ball more, while continuing to use his natural knack for scoring and rebounding.
